items.title: Deliver the Quanthus Data & Indicator Catalog
items.scope: Build a deterministic read-only catalog over existing data, feature, label and semantic authorities, expose it through API and /catalog UI, and freeze maintenance gates.
acceptance: All five child issues closed with repository evidence
Catalog snapshot is deterministic and authority-backed
Viewer/operator/admin can search and inspect through read-only API/UI
Drift gates prevent silent formula, field, namespace or relation changes
No new indicator formula or execution authority is created by catalog delivery
Production API/Web deployment and authenticated Catalog smoke pass

items.title: Freeze Catalog schema, authority and relation semantics
items.scope: Define stable entry kinds, identities, lifecycle/verification states, authority bindings, relation types and gap semantics without creating a parallel formula authority.
acceptance: Entry identity and exact kind vocabulary frozen
Authority references and source digests mandatory
Relation types distinguish exact equivalence from related/replacement
Usage clocks remain outside Fact/indicator catalog semantics
Invalid/dangling/duplicate entries fail closed

items.title: Generate deterministic Catalog snapshot from authoritative sources
items.scope: Implement explicit ODS, DWD, Feature, Label and Semantic source adapters and generate the checked catalog snapshot plus gap ledger.
acceptance: DWD 33 tables and inherited/time-profile fields projected from machine schema
ODS machine-declared datasets projected without prose scraping
Feature specs, LabelCards and semantic concepts/families projected
SMA20, RSI14, MACD-reserved and turnover-vs-rate regression cases pass
Independent generation is byte-identical

items.title: Expose authenticated read-only Catalog API
items.scope: Add a manifest-governed read-only Platform feature providing summary, search, detail and relations over the frozen snapshot.
acceptance: viewer/operator/admin receive catalog:read permission
Summary/search/detail/relations routes admitted by feature manifest
Query and page-size bounds enforced
OpenAPI and API authorization tests pass
No database writes or market-value queries are introduced

items.title: Build the /catalog search and detail UI
items.scope: Create a first-class authenticated /catalog page with search, filters, result list, detail, relations, authority/time metadata and gap visibility.
acceptance: First-class /catalog route admitted in Web manifest
Free-text search and structured filters usable from desktop UI
Reserved concept vs executable spec and accepted scope visibly distinct
Authority, time semantics, formula/spec and relations are inspectable
Web build, lint and UI contract/e2e tests pass

items.title: Freeze Catalog drift gates and maintenance closeout
items.scope: Make generated snapshot drift, missing authority metadata, orphan relations and silent formula/namespace substitutions repository-gating failures; close documentation and issue lifecycle.
acceptance: Regeneration drift test is exact and deterministic
All registered source definitions are covered or explicitly gapped
Legacy related-not-equivalent links cannot become aliases silently
Full repository and Web gates pass
Parent and child issues close in dependency order with final evidence
Production API/Web deployment and authenticated Catalog smoke pass
